summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Slipstream (Expo Web) at mobile viewport 375x667. Home, Run, Garage, Prestige all render and navigate correctly, no console errors, no red-screens. Run start works, score increments (19 -> 136 in ~2.5s), player renders, pause returns home, garage shows seeded tiles + empty crates + disabled export button with '155cc FI engine' text, garage-ride navigates to /run, garage-back to /. Prestige shows all four upgrade cards; tapping upgrade-buy-scoreMult with 0 tokens shows a toast reading 'Not enough Syndicate Tokens' and does NOT change token count (stays 0). prestige-back navigates to /. ONE ISSUE FOUND: Plain taps (mouse click without translation) inside run-play-area do NOT change lanes on web. Swipes (mouse-down + drag + mouse-up) work correctly and change lanes both left and right, so gameplay is functional, but the ready-screen instruction 'Swipe or tap left / right to change lanes' does not hold for pure taps in the web build. Root cause: run.tsx uses only Gesture.Pan().onEnd() to detect taps (translation<12). On react-native-gesture-handler web, Pan requires a minActivationDistance>0, so a click with zero movement never activates Pan and onEnd never fires, meaning handleTap is never invoked.

ui_bugs.issue: Pure taps (click with no translation) inside run-play-area do not change lanes on web. Only swipes/drags work. Ready-screen instructions promise tap-to-change-lane. Fix: compose Gesture.Tap() with Pan via Gesture.Race()/Gesture.Exclusive() so a tap dispatches handleTap(absoluteX) independently. Reference: /app/frontend/app/run.tsx:311-334

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/run.tsx, add a dedicated Gesture.Tap() that calls handleTap(absoluteX) and compose it with the existing Pan gesture (e.g., const combined = Gesture.Exclusive(pan, tap); or Gesture.Simultaneous). This will make plain taps change lanes on web where Pan does not activate without movement.
Optionally verify tap-only lane change with a native build (iOS/Android Expo Go) — the same fix will be needed there too if minDistance defaults are non-zero.
critical_code_review_comments: run.tsx handleTap is only reachable through Pan.onEnd, which requires activation via movement on RN Gesture Handler Web (uses hammer.js/pan recognizer with minimum distance). A dedicated Tap gesture is required for the advertised tap-to-lane behavior.
run.tsx: mutable game state stored in useRef({}).current with dynamic property assignments (`any`) — works but is fragile; consider typed state or useReducer for the run loop.
run.tsx is ~857 lines — consider splitting HUD, overlays, and gesture logic into separate files (>700 line guideline).

rca_of_issue: Reproduction: Navigate to /run, tap 'TAP TO RIDE', then mouse.click at (playArea.x+20, y) — player x stays 203.5 (center). RCA: /app/frontend/app/run.tsx uses `Gesture.Pan().onEnd(...)` with a tap-inside-onEnd fallback (translation<12). react-native-gesture-handler on web requires Pan to activate via movement; a 0-translation click never triggers onStart/onEnd, so handleTap is never called. Mitigation: add `const tap = Gesture.Tap().onEnd((e) => runOnJS(handleTap)(e.absoluteX));` and use `Gesture.Race(pan, tap)` or `Gesture.Exclusive(pan, tap)` in the GestureDetector.
